LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_ProfileDesc: Direct hostile kills store short-lived cutting echoes for the next confirmed melee hit.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_ChargesDesc: A direct hostile kill stores one echo. Echo damage cannot create another echo.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_DecayValue: Expires after {0} seconds without another kill
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_DecayDesc: All stored echoes expire together when the array stops confirming direct hostile kills.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_EchoValue: {0} Cut, {1}% AP to one nearby hostile
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_EchoDesc: The next confirmed melee hit spends one stored echo on one other living hostile pawn within the listed local range.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_RangeDesc: The array checks only the local radial cells around the struck target; it does not scan the map.
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_LimitsValue: Hostile pawns only; one echo per hit; no chaining
LanguageData.ABY_CrownScissionArray_LimitsDesc: Buildings, corpses and the primary target are never valid echo targets. Echo damage cannot store or trigger another echo.
